test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-6) Official paper (Held On: 9 May 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Eight colleagues K, L, M, N, O, P, Q and R are seated in a circle facing the centre. N is an immediate neighbour of both L and Q. P is an immediate neighbour of both K and R. O is second to the right of K. Which of the following is definitely true about M's position?

options.text: Second to the left of L

solution:
Given that:-

 
• P is an immediate neighbour of both K and R.
 
• O is second to the right of K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a349b2137a2293d6fe1a6af65dc8a571aa045dd50b5527f66a80cbda1ce827d1.png] 

 
• N is an immediate neighbour of both L and Q.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a9b3e8d1e79bd2a90148f1f31a8dd09a155be66462a07013c9e39d2e0c23596.png] 

 
• "M is exactly between K and O" is a definitely true statement about M's position.

Hence, **"option 2"** is the correct answer.
